items.claim: [r56-4] carried: `envNumber` read a keyword font weight as the fallback
items.note: The new `envFontWeight` reads `normal` as 400 and `bold` as 700. It falls back on `bolder`, `lighter`, and any weight outside 1–1000. `buttonMetrics` and `menuPanelMetrics` now use it, and it has its own changeset.

items.claim: [r57-5] carried: `envNumber` read a percentage or a keyword as a bare number
items.note: (no longer applies): `envNumber` now only accepts a unitless CSS number, so a percentage or a keyword falls back, and `measure.test.ts` already covers this.

items.claim: Current menu row measured at weight 400 though the DOM draws it bold (A+B, two findings)
`nestHold` keeps an outer hold's reason while that hold is off
`controlAccess` counts an empty reason as a reason
Empty row-list state measured upright though `ItemList` sets it in italic (A+B, two findings)
`runs()` accepts a fractional or infinite `WEASEL_PBT_RUNS`
items.note: No changeset because it is a test-only fixture. The same `runs()` sits in other packages' `pbt.fixture.ts` files (animator, audio, bidi, clock, and others) and in `apps/forge/fonts.pbt.test.ts`. Those are outside this area and I left them alone.

items.claim: `measureButton` shrinks the label to any width, but the DOM label can't go below its min-content
items.note: I changed the DOM to match the measure, which is also how the HUD button behaves. The label now has `min-width: 0`, `white-space: nowrap`, `overflow-x: clip` and `text-overflow: ellipsis`. The link variant still wraps (`white-space: normal`).
